## Content rules

Tick only what applies; delete the rest.

- [ ] No fabricated reviews, ratings, project counts, or years in business
- [ ] Any new imagery is self-hosted and has descriptive alt text
- [ ] Any AI-generated image is `assetType: 'concept-render'` and carries the badge
- [ ] Any new page has a unique title, description, canonical and Quick Answer
- [ ] Any new page is linked from navigation or the footer (no orphans)
- [ ] Costs are published as ranges, not fixed prices
